title: MZ Solved - Art Doesn't Update In Game

posts.author: PlasticSpoon
posts.body:
[Solved]
I saved the same test file in both character folder and sv actor folder and was referencing an unchanged one. Apologies. I am very new to this software.
I am very new to RPG maker mz and I have updated some character art and successfully used it in game but when I try and update that art it doesn't reload in game or editor. Is it cached somewhere? Not sure what to do as the art doesn't update even after restarting rpg maker.
Any help greatly appreciated.

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
Changes to art of actors won’t be reflected to saved games, so you’d need to start a new game.
Also, please follow the template if you’re unsure how to best post your questions. It has READ in all caps with three exclamation marks for a reason

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
where and how did you update your art?
when you create a new project, the default assets are copied from a template directory to the project directory.
after that, you need to change them in the project directory as the template directory will be ignored after project creation.

posts.author: PlasticSpoon
posts.body:
